newsitem.title: PERU: Youth's disapproval of Peru's Fujimori 78 pct-poll.
newsitem.headline: Youth's disapproval of Peru's Fujimori 78 pct-poll.

text.p: An overwhelming 78 percent of university students throughout Lima disapprove of President Alberto Fujimori's running of Peru, while only 19 percent approve, according to a Lima University poll published Monday.

The respected pollster also said 95 percent of students in the capital believe the government's congressional parties do not respect the country's constitution. Students have held huge rallies this month protesting a Congressional vote that ousted three Constitutional Court judges in May.

Local media published the results of the Lima University one-off survey, which was conducted at several state and private universities. The number of students polled and the survey's margin of error were not available.

In a separate survey conducted by Peru's leading pollster Apoyo SA, 60 percent of adults in Lima said they disapproved of Fujimori, compared to 56 percent the week before, while 34 percent approved of his presidency, down from 37 percent.

Answering questions analyzing Peru's political risks, 31 percent of those surveyed said a new armed conflict with neighboring Ecuador was "very likely", according to Apoyo. A further 34 percent said fighting was "quite probable" and 13 percent believed it unlikely.

In 1995, the two Andean countries fought a brief war, which left scores of soldiers dead and hundreds more injured. The neighbors' rival claims over a remote stretch of the Amazon jungle is Latin America's most tense border dispute.
Apoyo also said 36 percent believed a coup in Peru during the next 12 months was likely, while 57 percent said it was unlikely, according to results published in the financial daily Gestion.
The Apoyo survey was taken before the pro-government newspaper Expreso began reporting Friday that the opposition was plotting to oust Fujimori in a coup.
Apoyo surveyed 400 adults in the capital over three days last week, but the poll's margin of error was not given.
